description: Optical glass data copied from manufacturer catalogs. Units: density g/cm^3; cte 1e-6/K (-30..+70 C); thermal_conductivity W/(m K); specific_heat J/(kg K); youngs_modulus GPa; knoop_hardness as published by the vendor; dn_dT_abs_e 1e-6/K (e-line, +20..+40 C, Schott only); dn_dT_constants are the Schott-formula constants D0, D1, D2, E0, E1, lambda_tk (um). internal_transmittance_10mm maps wavelength (nm) to the internal transmittance of a 10 mm sample. relative_price is the vendor's own index (Schott: N-BK7 = 1; CDGM: H-K9L = 1). Dispersion: 'sellmeier' n^2 = 1 + sum B l^2/(l^2 - C); 'hoya_laurent' n^2 = A0 + A1 l^2 + A2 l^-2 + A3 l^-4 + A4 l^-6 + A5 l^-8; wavelength l in micrometres.
